title: normalize-sse-chunk-coalescing-and-avoid-sentinel-overflow
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: In production we observed rare cases where small SSE fragments produced during backpressure replay would cause duplicate or dropped function-call sentinels and corrupt partial JSON payloads. This manifested as: 1) trailing sentinel markers emitted twice when a coalescing window boundary coincided with a replayed tail fragment, 2) partial JSON objects split across coalesced chunks with no robust boundary marker, and 3) occasional out-of-order emission of function-call/assistant->tool handoff tokens under aggressive requeue behavior. Changes: 1) Normalized the coalescing window: the coalescer now enforces a deterministic chunk-join policy that never merges a fragment that ends with an open JSON span with a following fragment that begins with an unmatched sentinel. 2) Introduced a "skip-sentinel" guard: when a replayed tail fragment would produce a sentinel duplicate, the guard drops the duplicate sentinel and records a reproducible marker in the connection state so downstream consumers can detect and recover if they missed the original sentinel. 3) Per-connection tail requeue logic updated to preserve explicit function-call boundaries: requeued fragments are stamped with a monotonic fragment-index and a boolean "boundary-anchored" flag to keep ordering stable across retransmit attempts. 4) UTF-8-aware fragment coalescer: ensures we never split multi-byte sequences across emission boundaries, preventing malformed JSON when a UTF-8 boundary falls on a chunk cut. 5) Added regression tests and an integration harness that replays production capture traces at different latency/backpressure profiles. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for coalescer and sentinel guard - [x] Integration replay harness reproduces previously observed failure trace - [x] Performance microbench to ensure <5% median latency regression - [x] Add compatibility shim for consumers that expect legacy sentinel duplication (feature-flagged off by default) Rollout: Feature gated behind compatibilityToggle.sseSkipSentinel; gradual rollout 5%->25%->100% with canary checks for structured-output regressions. Notes: this is targeted and low-risk; it addresses a long-standing edge-case affecting function-call semantics and partial JSON stability.
commit_summary: 1) normalize: coalescer deterministic join and utf8 guards; 2) fix: skip-sentinel guard and fragment-index stamping; 3) test: add replay harness and new unit tests; 4) docs: describe compatibility toggle and rollout plan

release_notes: Fix SSE coalescing edge cases that could duplicate or drop function-call sentinels and corrupt partial JSON payloads under backpressure replay. Feature gated; enabled for all in next minor unless rollback criteria met.
